name: ai-sdlc
description: Spec-driven AI SDLC pipeline (v2). Risk-first slicing with a split in-loop spike gate (feasibility + post-synthesis design), a tier-gated 3-blind-designer design tournament with reality-grounded synthesis, method-heterogeneous adversarial review (Builder + 3 forked Critics independent by method+artifact, not model: forward-checklist /critique vs backward-premortem /critique-review vs post-build /code-review, each with an approach-level reframe, expert-independent), a per-gate measurement spine (precision + recall: gate-log verdict + miss rows, reality-contact ranked), bidirectional Critic calibration (add from misses + safely-lighten low-value model gates, reality spine exempt), grounded product-doc authoring with a drift-check stale-doc loop, JSON vault artifacts, and a unified candidate backlog. Skills, agents, and shared tooling bundled as one plugin.

_layout.skills/<name>/: SKILL.md (runnable) + skill.json (generated design manifest) + examples/ (output JSON examples) + scripts/ (single-skill tools)
_layout.agents/: named Critic/worker personas (system prompts) referenced by context:fork skills
_layout.scripts/lib/: shared tooling used by >1 skill: vault_edit (SVW-1 safe-write), risk_register_audit, _worktree_paths, active_slice + injection helpers, the _stdout/_vault_* helpers
